jsonLD.description:
Business Intelligence Developer -- SQL \& Data Integration
==========================================================

**Location:** Beaufort County, SC  

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid  

**Compensation:** $35.18--$41.97 per hour  

**Schedule:** Full-time

About the Opportunity
- --------------------

We are recruiting on behalf of a mission-driven public-sector organization seeking an experienced Business Intelligence Developer -- SQL \& Data Integration to join its data team.

This role sits at the intersection of data, technology, business process improvement, reporting, and automation. It is ideal for someone who enjoys looking at a manual or inefficient process and asking, *"How can we make this work better through data and technology?"*

You will work with data from existing systems and use SQL, Power BI, data integration, scripting, and automation to make information more connected, accurate, accessible, and useful across the organization.

This is more technical than a traditional Data Analyst position, but it is not a traditional Database Administrator or Data Engineer role. Rather than building or administering the organization's core source systems, you will work with available data, integrate information across systems, automate repetitive workflows, and create solutions that make day-to-day operations more efficient.

What You'll Do
- -------------

In this role, you will:

* Develop, write, and optimize SQL queries, views, stored procedures, and parameterized scripts to improve data access and operational workflows.
* Work with existing database structures and available back-end data to develop reliable, scalable solutions for internal users.
* Develop a strong understanding of existing systems, data structures, relationships, and dependencies.
* Integrate data from systems that do not naturally communicate with one another.
* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, data models, and visualizations that provide meaningful, actionable insights.
* Use advanced DAX and Power Query capabilities to transform and model data.
* Automate repetitive processes and workflows using tools such as Python, PowerShell, SQL, Power Query, or similar technologies.
* Replace manual Excel-, Word-, and click-intensive processes with more efficient, technology-driven solutions.
* Structure and prepare data so end users receive information in a usable format with minimal manual manipulation required.
* Identify and resolve data discrepancies to maintain accuracy, reliability, and data integrity.
* Evaluate existing business processes and identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary steps, manual effort, and duplication.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
* Coordinate with external vendors regarding data transfers, integrations, security requirements, and technical issues.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that support efficiency and scalability.
* Share best practices and technical knowledge with other members of the data team.

The organization is specifically looking for someone who can combine technical expertise with a strong understanding of how data supports real-world business operations.

What This Looks Like in Practice
- -------------------------------

Many of the organization's existing processes have historically required employees to export data, manipulate spreadsheets, sort information manually, or repeat the same steps each time a report or workflow is needed.

Your goal will be to reduce that manual effort.

Instead of simply creating another spreadsheet or macro, you may use SQL to organize and prepare the data earlier in the process, create an automated workflow, integrate data from multiple sources, or build a Power BI solution that gives users the information they need in a ready-to-use format.

The end goal is to allow employees to focus on the work that requires their expertise rather than spending time manually preparing data.

What We're Looking For
- ---------------------

The successful candidate will bring real-world experience working with SQL, business intelligence, data integration, and automation.

Qualifications include:

* Approximately 5 years of experience in database development, ETL, data integration, business intelligence, data engineering, or a related area.
* Intermediate-to-advanced SQL skills, including professional experience writing queries and working with relational databases.
* Experience developing complex queries and working with database tables, relationships, views, stored procedures, and data transformations.
* Strong Power BI experience, including data modeling, DAX, and Power Query.
* Experience with ETL and data integration processes.
* Experience using Python, PowerShell, or another scripting language for workflow or data automation.
* Strong understanding of data quality, accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
* Experience identifying inefficient processes and developing technical solutions to improve them.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
* Familiarity with version-control tools such as Git.
* Strong organizational and project-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a changing environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and personal accountability.

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent professional experience may also be considered. The original role criteria call for a related bachelor's degree or eight years of equivalent experience, along with at least five years of database development, ETL, or data-engineering experience.

You May Be a Great Fit If...
- ---------------------------

You are someone who understands that the best technical solution starts with understanding the business problem.

You enjoy asking questions such as:

* Why are employees doing this manually?
* Why are we moving the same information between systems over and over?
* Can SQL prepare this data before it ever reaches Excel?
* Can this workflow be automated?
* Can Power BI provide users with what they need without rebuilding the same report each month?

You are comfortable working in an environment where systems may not always connect seamlessly and where you may need to develop creative solutions using the data and technical access available to you.

You also enjoy working with both technical and non-technical colleagues and can translate a business need into a practical data solution.

What This Role Is --- and Isn't
- ------------------------------

This role **is** a hands-on technical position involving:

* SQL development
* Business intelligence
* Power BI
* Data integration
* Workflow automation
* ETL
* Data quality
* Business process improvement

This role is not primarily:

* IT help desk or technical support
* Database administration
* Software engineering
* Systems administration
* Traditional data analysis focused only on reporting
* Full-scale data engineering or database architecture

Instead, this person serves as the bridge between existing systems, available data, business processes, and the people who rely on that information.

Work Environment
- ---------------

This position is part of a collaborative data team and works with both internal stakeholders and external technology partners.

The role offers a hybrid work environment, but candidates should be located within reasonable proximity of Beaufort County, South Carolina. Candidates within the broader Beaufort, Charleston, Savannah, or Columbia region may be considered depending on their ability to meet in-person requirements.

This is not a fully remote, work-from-anywhere position.

The organization values people who demonstrate initiative, accountability, continuous learning, collaboration, and a willingness to find better ways of working. The successful candidate should be equally comfortable independently solving a technical problem and partnering with a colleague to understand why a current process is not working.

Compensation
- -----------

The anticipated compensation range for this position is:

$35.18--$41.97 per hour

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and alignment with the requirements of the role.

* **Role:** Senior Machine Learning Engineer
* **Location:** Remote
* **Employment Type:** Full-time

**Compensation:** Competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location. **Indicative range:** $150,000 -- $250,000 (USD equivalent), plus benefits.

**Role Overview**

We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the design, training, and deployment of ML systems in production. The role combines deep ML expertise with strong software engineering --- owning models from research through scaled inference.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Design, train, and deploy machine learning models at production scale

- Lead architecture decisions for training, evaluation, and inference pipelines

- Build evaluation frameworks and monitoring for model quality and drift

- Partner with data engineering on training data pipelines and feature stores

- Mentor junior ML engineers and contribute to ML practice

- Stay current on research and bring proven techniques into production

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

- 5 years in machine learning engineering with production ownership

- Strong Python skills and deep experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow

- Experience training and serving models at scale (deep learning, LLMs, or classical ML)

- Hands-on with cloud ML infrastructure (AWS Sagemaker, GCP Vertex, Databricks, or similar)

- Strong software engineering fundamentals (testing, code review, system design)

- Track record of shipping ML systems that delivered measurable business value

**What You'll Bring**

- Curiosity about how models behave and why they fail

- Rigor in following guidelines and flagging ambiguity early

- Strong written communication, including ability to document findings clearly

- Comfort working asynchronously across time zones

**What We Offer**

- Fully remote, flexible work hours

- Performance-based bonus structure

- Annual learning \& development stipend

- Health and wellness benefits (varies by location)

- Opportunity to work on high-scale, real-world impact projects

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

This is an equal opportunity role. Applications are welcomed from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, skills, and demonstrated ability.

**++A bit about us:++** We are a fast-growing SaaS company that builds a mission-critical, cloud-based platform used by thousands of organizations to manage daily operations, customer engagement, payments, and reporting. Our product supports high transaction volume, complex workflows, and a large, active user base. The company is privately held, profitable, and continues to invest heavily in its technology and product roadmap. Engineering plays a central role in driving innovation, scalability, and long-term growth.   

**++Why join us?++**

* Stable, growing product with an established customer base and long-term roadmap
* Meaningful engineering work on a platform used daily by a large, diverse user community
* Collaborative, low-ego team that values clean code, ownership, and thoughtful problem-solving
* Balanced environment focused on sustainable development practices, not constant fire drills
* Opportunity to work across legacy and modern systems, contributing to ongoing platform evolution  

**++Job Details++** We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong .NET (C#) background and prior experience developing applications in PHP/Laravel. This role is ideal for someone who has transitioned from PHP into the Microsoft stack or someone who is equally comfortable working across both technologies.   

You'll play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining backend services for a mature SaaS platform while helping support an evolving technology stack.   

What You'll Do:   

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services in a SaaS environment.
* Build new features primarily using .NET (C#) while also supporting existing PHP/Laravel applications.
* Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and business logic.
* Collaborate with Product, QA, and Engineering teams to deliver new functionality.
* Review project requirements and translate technical specifications into production-quality code.
* Troubleshoot performance, scalability, and reliability issues.
* Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and architectural discussions.
* Mentor junior and mid-level developers and help drive engineering best practices.  

What We're Looking For:   

* 7+ years of software development experience
* Strong experience with .NET (C#).
* Previous hands-on experience developing applications with PHP/Laravel.
* Experience with React (preferred) or Angular.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
* Strong understanding of software architecture and system design.
* Ability to balance technical debt with business priorities.
* Comfortable working independently in a collaborative Agile environment.  

Preferred Qualifications:   

* Experience working within SaaS platforms.
* Experience modernizing or migrating legacy applications.
* Cloud experience (Azure preferred).
* Passion for mentoring teammates and improving engineering processes.

jsonLD.description:
Are you passionate about the chance to bring your analytical processing experience to a world class organization that is leading the way in both content and technology to serve and protect our citizens home and abroad? Do you have the skills necessary to design new software solutions for customers? Then Thomson Reuters Special Services (TRSS) is looking for you!   

**About The Role** Thomson Reuters Special Services (TRSS) is looking for a Software Engineer to support our DoD/DoW customers. Software Engineers supporting these efforts work alongside data scientists and data engineers to develop advanced capabilities, prototype new applications, and deliver cutting edge products for high impact government missions. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, the initiative to operate with minimal direction, and the creativity to develop novel solutions.   

These positions are part of cross-functional teams that include Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Product Managers, Analysts, and other technical contributors. Software Engineers work to develop and deploy software that utilizes advanced ML/AI capabilities for mission and operational problem areas (e.g., Cyber Operations, Supply Chain Integrity, and other customer driven domains). These products are developed in collaboration with a team of Data Scientists and Data Engineers using modern development practices such as version control, automated testing, containerized deployments, code review, and iterative delivery. This is a hybrid role open to candidates in the Washington, DC area.   

**Skills** Outside of contract work, TRSS Software Engineers contribute to internal innovation by participating in research and development (R\&D), developing and maintaining shared capabilities, strengthening technical skills, and supporting business development efforts such as proof-of-concept projects and capabilities briefings. As a **Software Engineer** , you will also contribute to a variety of areas including:   

* Leading projects and acting as a mentor to less experienced developers
* Collaborating with the TRSS development team and design, implement, and deliver software solutions and data science efforts
* Enhancing and supporting existing applications
* Engaging the TRSS analytical staff to gather requirements, generate ideas, and develop documentation
* Demoing new software solutions as needed  

**A Note On Our Requirements** If you are excited about this role but your prior experience does not perfectly align with every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. TRSS is looking for self-starting, diverse candidates who thrive in collaborative environments and are eager to expand their technical horizons. **Your ability to learn quickly, take initiative, and collaborate effectively matters just as much** **as your current tech stack.** **About You** You're a good fit for the role of **Software Engineer** if you have/are:   

* 3-5 years of experience with Full-Stack Application Development.

As Senior Software Engineer, Content Lifecycle Operations, you will play a critical role in enabling the seamless flow of visual content---such as images, CGI, and 3D assets---across Crate and Barrel's content technology ecosystem, with a focus on Image Syndication \& Content Platform Integration.Your primary responsibility will be to design and support scalable systems that syndicate digital assets from central platforms (like DAMs and PIMs) to third-party endpoints, ensuring delivery is automated, trackable, and metadata-rich. You'll collaborate with cross-functional partners in creative, marketing, merchandising, and technology to implement system integrations, manage API-driven workflows, and maintain data consistency across platforms like DAM, PIM, CMS, and external retail/media channels. This role is highly cross-functional, requiring strong technical knowledge, platform administration skills, and a sharp eye for operational efficiency.   

* This position is fully remote
* This role is an Individual Contributor  

**A Day in the Life as a Senior Software Engineer, Content Lifecycle...**

* Design and development of complex software solutions supporting content lifecycle operations, digital asset management, content syndication, and platform integrations, ensuring they meet functional and non-functional requirements
* Actively participate in and champion Agile ceremonies, contributing to sprint planning, delivery, and continuous improvement
* Collaborate closely with product managers, content teams, architects, and stakeholders to understand business needs, refine requirements, and deliver scalable technical solutions
* Design, develop, and maintain APIs, microservices, and integration services connecting DAM, PIM, CMS, CDN, and third-party platforms
* Take ownership of key technical components from design through deployment, support, and ongoing maintenance
* Perform code reviews and promote engineering best practices, coding standards, and software quality
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across applications, integrations, and content delivery workflows
* Monitor system performance using dashboards, logs, and analytics tools to ensure reliable and efficient content delivery
* Contribute to architecture discussions and technical roadmaps, helping shape the future direction of content and integration platforms
* Partner with internal teams and vendors to build scalable, reliable, and maintainable integration solutions
* Support digital asset governance through metadata standards, taxonomy management, and content delivery best practices
* Create and maintain technical documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across the team
* Drive continuous learning and contribute to improvements in CI/CD, automation, observability, and DevOps practices  

**What You'll Bring To The Table...**

* Strong expertise in software design, system integration, and architectural patterns
* Deep understanding of Agile development methodologies and the software development lifecycle
* Experience designing and developing APIs, microservices, and integration solutions
* Working knowledge of digital asset management (DAM), product information management (PIM), content syndication, and content delivery platforms
* Understanding of metadata management, taxonomy standards, and content governance practices
* Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams
* Proven ability to mentor engineers and promote engineering best practices
* Experience building scalable, high-performance, and reliable software solutions
* Knowledge of software testing, automation, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices architecture, and DevOps practices
* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and analytics tools
* Understanding of database design, performance optimization, and security best practices  

**We'd Love to Hear From You If You Have...**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5 years of professional software development experience with increasing technical responsibility
* Proven experience designing and delivering complex software systems in an Agile environment
* Experience leading technical initiatives and driving projects from design through production support
* Strong proficiency in programming languages, frameworks, APIs, and integration technologies
* Experience working with DAM, CDN, or similar content management and integration platforms
* Experience in content operations, ecommerce, retail, or digital content ecosystems is a plus
